_doc: Run-wide survivor tuning (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md sections 5, 6; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Everything here is tier C (ours / emulator-like) unless a note says otherwise; canonical WZ numbers are never copied here except where noted as a survivor choice of equipment.

exp_curve._formula: Tier C: exp_to_next(L) = round(a + b*L + c*L^2): L1 22, L7 298, L9 454, L29 3774; 980 EXP to reach Lv8, 1806 to Lv10, 40426 to Lv30. Difficulty-overhaul candidate trained only on 1..60 and 2026; canonical EXP table unchanged.

mob_skills._doc: Tier C: enabled boss kits; slow x retains x percent of upgraded speed; defense x adds flat defense; heal x/y are inclusive random bounds;140 is timed self weapon immunity.

mob_projectiles._tier: tier C: swept body contact radius when the canonical ball has no lt/rb

player._start: Tier C: survivor starter stats, with the existing 50 HP / 5 MP and Three Snails rank 1.
player._ap: Tier C: 5 automatic AP per level; assign to the nearest job ancestor's primary stat, redistributing only earned AP when advancing.
player._equipment: Tier C: the worn starter outfit and weapon per job branch. Defense and avoid come unchanged from canonical equipment info in the asset cache.
player._body: Touch hitbox relative to the feet (x, y, w, h), roughly the v83 character's body + head.
player._cast: Targeting measures from cast_height px above the feet; shots start cast_forward px further toward their target (the throwing hand, in front of the body).

growth._int_mp: Tier B: Magician MP growth adds floor(INT / 10), using INT before spending that level's AP.

_portals: Same-map portals only: activation box relative to the portal point, lift above arrival before falling, global cooldown in seconds. Tier C: owner choice; source and destination points stay canonical.
_mob_speed_factor: mob move speed px/s = (speed stat + 100) x this x stage speed (MobKind.SPEED_SCALE is the same 0.625; a different value here rescales every mob)
_mob_motion: tier C: flyer vertical bob amplitude in pixels and period in seconds; pursuit still uses canonical flySpeed through mob_speed_factor
_regen: Tier B: MP recovers in 10-second pulses, base 3 plus floor(character level x Improved MP Recovery skill level / 10). Tier C: always recover 10 HP per pulse; hp_regen/mp_regen modifiers add to each pulse.
_pickup: EXP drops: pop speed and sideways spread (px/s), magnet start speed (px/s) and acceleration (px/s^2), live drop cap (the farthest from the player is absorbed into a fresh drop at each new kill), lifetime (s an uncollected drop lies before it expires, its EXP lost; 0 = never) and fade (its last seconds, fading out). They fall with Physics.img gravity/fallSpeed.

bot._doc: Tier C: sensible-policy final score overrides keyed by card ID; prioritize Guard before learning another attack. No job bonus is added. Missing entries preserve legacy scoring; random card choices remain uniform.

_potions: Tier C: starter stock, independent HP/MP drop chances per monster (higher for elites), and bot drink thresholds. Restore amounts come from each current item's canonical spec.

potions._bot: Tier C: drink below 70% HP/30% MP; potion-tier score112 prioritizes permanent supply upgrades above Guard and attack cards. Random cards remain random.

_spawn: SpawnDirector (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md 4): margin outside the view, band of the first spawn ring and band_y, how far it reaches above and below the view (the floors beside the view; -1 = band), min distance to the player, samples per ring, recycle distance (px) and time (s) of the far/unreachable relocation rule, prefer_route (a ring first looks for a point whose NavGraph travel cost to the player is at most half the view width + margin + this many px; -1 = any reachable point), stall_time (s an off-screen mob may go without coming stall_progress px closer by moving itself before it is relocated ahead of the player; 0 = never), trail_margin (px the margin grows on the side the player moves away from: the camera lags about 29 px behind a running player).
_bosses: Tier C: warning/placement/pressure, stalled-pursuit fade relocation, canonical EXP reward multiplier and shower geometry, current-tier potion bundles and bonus choice count; stage entries may override rewards.
_run_time_cap: Tier C: balance/full-run harness timeout, allowing the finale to continue beyond 15:00.
